papers.title: Postcard from Jamestown
lines: Jacob's Ladder has 699 steps, and I have counted them with my knees.
At the top there is a view, a kettle and a man who asks if I'd like to go down again.

papers.title: Coffee grower's note
lines: The Green Tipped Bourbon grows in the high gardens, one of the world's rarest beans.
Roasted in small batches. Drunk in smaller ones. Spoken of in whispers, mostly by me.

trail.clue: A planter hid a tin of coffee money near the beached boat. 'Under the oldest bush, as always.'

papers.title: Gardener's report
lines: The exile in the big house was a great man once. Now he complains about the damp and the roof.
I plant roses. He criticises them. Roses outlive everyone.

papers.title: Passenger's diary
lines: Five days from Cape Town, six if the sea wished. Land arrives in the morning as a grey shape and then a green one.
The ship is called the island's lifeline. The island is called nothing, because it is too busy being itself.
